summary:
SEND-132 ONE-EDITOR-TWO-STAGES — frontend end-to-end verified against rig estimate 7e050ee7-f842-4495-b52c-51273217955d (Howard's ZZ TEST_send132 UI RIG). All 11 acceptance criteria pass. Sequence to reach the per-photo grid: AI MEASURE → dismiss ai-measure-onboarding-modal → yellow 'SAVED WORK' Resume button. Both photos then render ai-measure-photo-annotate-{i} AND ai-measure-photo-takeoff-{i} (Annotate NOT retired). 

(1) STAGE 2 PHOTO (index 0, ai_c7b431...jpg): banner reads 'STAGE 2 — AFTER AI', propose-btn ENABLED. First press mints 4 AI-PROPOSAL opening boxes (rows and canvas boxes). Provenance badge = 'AI PROPOSAL'; basis line names it 'AI PROPOSAL — minted from the completed read on this photo; provisional until the contractor rules on it'. Second press → mark count STAYS at 4 (idempotent ✓). No siding/non-siding zones invented — only opening proposals.

(2) STAGE 2 CONFIRM = EVIDENCE: two-tap scale (10 ft) sets basis 'TWO-TAP ANCHOR — 1.020 ft per 12 px span'. Confirming one AI proposal flips the basis line to 'EVIDENCE — an AI proposal on this photo, checked and confirmed by the contractor'; qty-opening-count fills to 1, qty-opening-sqft fills to 1.2. No 'guidance-confirmed' note laundered onto that mark.

(3) STAGE 1 PHOTO (index 1, 347130b...jpg): banner reads 'STAGE 1 — BEFORE AI'; propose-btn DISABLED. photo-takeoff-proposals-refusal names it: 'no completed AI read carries this photo — Stage 2 is not unlocked here; a read on another photo unlocks nothing on this one'. Drawing a 4-corner siding polygon and pressing confirm BEFORE scale is refused by name: toast 'no scale on this photo — set the two-tap anchor or type the tape figure; no scale, no quantity'; mark stays PROVISIONAL, qty-siding stays '—'.

(4) GUIDANCE NEVER LAUNDERED: after setting scale (10 ft, 0.630 ft/12px) and re-confirming the same zone, badge reads 'GUIDANCE-CONFIRMED' (NOT EVIDENCE); basis line reads 'GUIDANCE-CONFIRMED — no AI read on this photo. It carries quantity; it is NOT evidence that an AI read was checked'; qty-siding FILLS to 7.03 ft² (guidance confirm still writes quantity — correct per Howard's ruling).

(5) IMPORT CARRIES STYLE + HEIGHT, ONCE: 'pull in what I already drew' adds 2 provisional marks — STONE non-siding zone (4.79 ft²) + OPENING labelled '2-Lite Slider'. Selecting the opening row: photo-takeoff-style-input='2-Lite Slider', photo-takeoff-height-in='36', photo-takeoff-width-in='48' ✓. Both badges read 'GUIDANCE · IMPORTED'. Second import press: toast 'Nothing new to pull in', mark count stays at 3 (idempotent ✓).

(6) STYLE + HEIGHT EDITABLE: typed 'Casement' / '48' into style-input / height-in and tabbed out. After close + reopen and re-selecting the opening row, style='Casement', height='48' persisted ✓.

(7) PRODUCT CHANGE RECORDED, MARK STAYS CONFIRMED: photo-takeoff-product-select on the CONFIRMED siding zone offers EXACTLY the two body-siding products ['TEST 38 Series Lap 3/8" x 8" x 16\'', 'TEST Board & Batten Panel'] — 'TEST J blocks' accessory is NOT offered ✓. After picking Lap then swapping to Board & Batten: row status remains 'confirmed' / 'GUIDANCE-CONFIRMED' (NOT reverted to provisional); photo-takeoff-product-history-{id} shows two lines with from→to, sqft_at_swap=7.03, timestamp '2026-08-27 01:34' and user 'hhunt6677@yahoo.com'; photo-takeoff-qty-by-product chip moved to 'TEST Board & Batten Panel · 7.03 ft²'.

(8) GEOMETRY STILL DROPS THE CONFIRMATION: pressing photo-takeoff-adjust-{id} revealed a photo-takeoff-vertex-{id}-0 handle; dragging it moved the vertex (7.03 → 3.52 ft²), row status flipped to PROVISIONAL / 'GUIDANCE', reason line reads 'geometry changed after confirmation — re-confirm the new figure'. Live siding qty dropped that mark out. Product-change vs geometry-change rules DO NOT BLUR ✓.

(9) APPLY WRITES QUANTITY ONLY: photo-takeoff-apply-btn toast: 'Quantities written — siding 0 ft² · non-siding 0 ft² · openings 1. No money written.' — consistent with post-drag state (the S1 siding zone was demoted to provisional by the vertex drag; the S1 stone/opening imports were left provisional; only the S2 confirmed AI opening remained → openings=1). Toast text explicitly names 'No money written.'

(10) ANNOTATE STILL PRESENT: ai-measure-photo-annotate-0 AND ai-measure-photo-annotate-1 both render alongside their photo-takeoff siblings ✓ (per Howard's standing order — Annotate stays until he verifies the import on a real session).

No defects found. All UI, testids, provenance labels, refusal-by-name copy, and idempotency guarantees match SEND-132 spec verbatim. The backend is already 13-pin green (test_send132_one_editor_two_stages_2026_08_26.py) and the frontend now matches.
critical_code_review_comments: PhotoTakeoffEditor.jsx is now 719 lines — 19 lines over the 700-line comfort threshold noted in iter 58. Splitting the right rail (Scale block, Quantities block, Marks list, Product picker) into subcomponents would keep the editor sustainable as SEND-133+ lands.
AIMeasureButton.jsx is still 5,383+ lines (flagged in prior iterations). Overdue for a split but explicitly out of scope for this SEND per Howard's parking of the blueprint pipeline.
The full-page apply toast wraps siding/non-siding/openings on one line; on narrow screens the '. No money written.' suffix can be cut off. Non-blocking — cosmetic only.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Sequence for SEND-132 UI: (1) AI MEASURE → onboarding dismiss → yellow SAVED-WORK Resume (NOT the purple-header TIPS button). (2) Photo grid then renders 2 rows with ai-measure-photo-annotate-{i} AND ai-measure-photo-takeoff-{i} testids. (3) Photo 0 = Stage 2 (green banner, propose ENABLED); Photo 1 = Stage 1 (blue banner, propose DISABLED + refusal chip visible). Key finding: after propose+confirm on Stage 2, badge basis reads 'EVIDENCE — …'; after guidance confirm on Stage 1, badge basis reads 'GUIDANCE-CONFIRMED — no AI read on this photo. It carries quantity; it is NOT evidence…' — these two strings are the load-bearing distinction. Product picker on Stage 1 offers ONLY body-siding products (Lap + Board&Batten) — accessory 'J blocks' correctly excluded. Product swap keeps confirmation; vertex drag drops it — do NOT conflate the two.
